title: crotalaria novae-hollandiae subsp. lasiophylla
intro: Crotalaria novae-hollandiae subsp. lasiophylla, commonly known as Australian rattle pod, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Australian rattle pod include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antiparasitic effects. The plant's leaves and pods have been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions.
